name: route
description: Hands feature and test work to delegate's cheaper worker: a fast classifier (ScaleDown) reads your prompt, and only where it is feature or test work does Claude get the order to implement it through a hand-off. Off until you turn it on and give it a ScaleDown key.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Off until you turn it on (here or in /mods): from then on the text of each prompt you send goes to ScaleDown, a US service, to be classified.

scaledownKey.title: ScaleDown API key
scaledownKey.description: Else the SCALEDOWN_API_KEY environment variable. The prompt's text is sent to ScaleDown (a US service) to be classified.

minScore.title: Hand off from (classifier score)
minScore.description: Only a prompt the classifier calls feature or test work with at least this score gets the order.
